notes: Copy this file outside the code repository or into a private ops evidence location before filling it; repo-local production evidence files cannot unlock live-order readiness.
Do not include API keys, bearer tokens, database URLs, private keys, raw Authorization headers, or user secrets.

Use only documented schema fields. Root fields: version, evidence_run_id, generated_at, expires_at, cutover_window, cutover_approval_ref, secret_values_returned, notes, items. Item fields: status, validated_at, validated_by, evidence_summary, artifact_refs, secret_values_returned.
Root notes are optional and must be a bounded list of concise strings; do not use notes for raw logs, model output, traces, or pasted operational dumps.
The items object must contain only the documented external acceptance item ids in this template; unknown item ids are rejected.

evidence_run_id must be a unique sanitized operations run id for this production acceptance attempt, 12-80 chars, letters/numbers/dot/underscore/colon/hyphen only; cutover_approval_ref must include it, and each item artifact_ref must include it plus the item id.

generated_at, expires_at, and item validated_at must be timezone-aware ISO-8601; generated_at/validated_at cannot be >300s in the future; item validation cannot be older than 7 days at generated_at; expires_at must be after generated_at, future, and within 7 days.
cutover_window.start_at/end_at must be timezone-aware ISO-8601, contain the production audit time, and be no longer than 8 hours.
cutover_approval_ref must point to one sanitized ops://, lark://, notion://, or https:// approval record for the exact live-order cutover window and include evidence_run_id.

artifact_refs must be non-empty item-specific sanitized refs using https://, ops://, lark://, or notion:// only; use no more than 5 per item, each <=300 chars, include evidence_run_id plus item id, never reuse refs across items, and avoid credentials/local/private URLs.

Each item must become status=accepted with validated_at, a non-placeholder validated_by of 3-120 characters, a concrete evidence_summary of 24-600 characters, artifact_refs, and secret_values_returned=false before production cutover audit can pass.
When an item is status=accepted, evidence_summary must mention that item's required non-secret proof terms from --explain-production-evidence; generic summaries are rejected.
